source_facts: The Index Administrator's application of the described method is final and binding.
The Index Administrator shall apply the described method for Index composition and calculation.
Market, supervisory, legal, financial, or tax reasons may require method changes.
The Index Administrator may change Index terms and conditions and the calculation method.
Such changes may prevent obvious or demonstrable error.
Such changes may remedy, correct, or supplement incorrect terms and conditions.
The Index Administrator is not obliged to provide information on modifications or changes.
The Index Administrator will take appropriate steps to ensure a consistent calculation method.
render_facts: The Index Administrator applies the described method to the Index.
The described method is the method for Index composition and calculation.
The application of the described method by the Index Administrator is final and binding.
For each Change Reason, the corresponding potential method change relates to the described method.
A deemed modification or change of the Index is a change to the Index Terms and Conditions or to the calculation method applied to the Index.
A deemed modification or change is deemed necessary and desirable by the Index Administrator.
A deemed modification or change prevents an obvious or demonstrable error.
A deemed modification or change addresses incorrect Index Terms and Conditions by remedying, correcting, or supplementing them.
The Index Administrator is not obliged to provide information on modifications or changes.
Appropriate steps ensure consistency between the calculation method applied to the Index and the described method.
